about_short_description.short_description: Elessar is an information technology company that boosts engineering productivity by integrating with the existing ecosystem of tools.

product.name: Elessar Engineering Visibility AI Assistant
product.description: An AI platform that integrates with existing tools to provide engineering visibility by connecting codebases, communications, and documentation.

product.name: AI-Generated Pull Request Changelogs
product.description: Automatically generates standardized changelogs for pull requests using AI to capture all changes and save time.

product.name: Notion Documentation and Weekly Reports
product.description: Automatically documents codebase progress and generates weekly reports in Notion for easy access and tracking.

identifier.value: Slack Bot with Temporary Channels and AI Summaries

product.name: Slack Bot with Temporary Channels and AI Summaries
product.description: Creates temporary Slack channels per pull request with two-way sync, status updates, and AI-generated summaries to improve communication and visibility.

identifier.value: VS Code Extension for Doc Search and Changelogs

product.name: VS Code Extension for Doc Search and Changelogs
product.description: A Visual Studio Code extension that allows users to search documentation and view pull request changelogs directly within the editor.

product.name: Integrated Issue Tracking with Linear
product.description: Automatically links issues, tasks, and metrics from Linear to Elessar channels and integrations for streamlined tracking.
